text:
elaine: Hey team — dropping the near-final launch blog draft for Redwood Optimize. Need two quick things before I push to the editor: (1) tone polish (make the technical bits approachable for PMs) and (2) confirm webinar CTA + inbound lead routing. Can folks tag tasks? :eyes:

raj: Thanks — reading now. Quick note: the intro is a touch dense. I'll try a lighter hook focused on cost savings + one customer line.

marta: For CTA routing, let's send webinar signups to the Growth pipeline with tag 'optimize_launch_2026' and nurture flow A. Can we split demo requests to AE queue?

ben: Yes, Sales prefers demo intents go straight to the SDR queue with priority 'high' and account size filter >$50k. If marketing-bot flags enterprise domain, route to Ben's team.

sam: Ops note: make sure the HubSpot form has a hidden field 'traffic_source=blog_optimize' so attribution is clean. I can add that and test webhook delivery.

raj: Working on the tone edits — changing paragraph 2 to: "Redwood Optimize reduces inference spend by intelligently suggesting batching and quantization settings, so engineering teams hit their latency SLO without surprise bills." Keeping one sentence of benchmark but linking to the benchmark page.

alex: Legal quick pass: avoid naming specific third-party models in the post. Also remove the phrasing 'guaranteed savings' — suggest 'typical savings observed in customer workloads'.

elaine: Good call, Alex. Replace 'guaranteed savings' with 'typical savings observed in production' and remove vendor names.

marta: Webinar CTA copy proposal: "See a cost-first demo — join our Optimize walkthrough + live Q&A" with primary button 'Reserve your seat' -> Growth pipeline. Secondary button 'Request demo' -> SDR queue.

ben: Also add an optional checkbox 'I want pricing info' that sets lead priority to high.

sam: I'll wire the form mapping. Can someone confirm which HubSpot list to add registrants to?

marta: Use list 'Optimize Launch Registrants 2026' — I'll create it and add segmentation rules for region and ARR band.

raj: One more editorial ask: can someone provide a one-paragraph customer quote for the top of the post? Prefer a short line about cost/perf impact.

ben: I'll surface a quote from Acme via SDR — ping me by noon and I'll escalate.

elaine: Action items summary (I'll also paste into the doc):
- Raj: editorial tone + swap benchmark link (ETA today EOD)
- Marta: create HubSpot list + confirm Growth mapping (ETA tomorrow)
- Sam: implement hidden fields + webhook test (ETA tomorrow)
- Ben: secure customer quote and confirm SDR routing rule (ETA today)
- Alex: legal wording changes applied (ETA today)
- Elaine: publish to editor after approvals and schedule webinar page pairing (ETA once above done)

marketing-bot: Reminder: editorial deadline in 48 hours for launch assets. :bell:

marta: Cool — I'll start the list and the email nurture draft. Tag me if you want PR-specific segmentation.

raj: I'll push a diff to the doc in Google Drive and tag the editor. Link coming in 10.

elaine: Thanks everyone — let's close this by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
